description: This file defines the OutcomeByMonthDashlet class, which extends DashletGenericChart, used to generate a dashboard chart for opportunity outcomes over months in the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for constructing database queries, rendering chart data, and configuring display options related to opportunity data segmentation by month and sales stage.

classes.name: OutcomeByMonthDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashboard chart class for visualizing monthly outcomes of opportunities, extending the generic chart dashlet with specific data queries and display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default or provided start and end dates for the data range, ensuring proper setup for the chart display.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Returns configuration options for the dashlet, particularly setting user-specific filtering options for opportunity IDs.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript code for rendering the chart, including data processing, chart configuration, and rendering logic via RGraph.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by month and sales stage within the specified date range and assigned users.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Transforms raw query results into structured data suitable for chart rendering, including labels, data points, tooltips, and keys.
